sources: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164, Subpart C) and Privacy Rule minimum necessary standard; NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2; NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.

rules.title: Clinical access with no treatment relationship
rules.review: Ask the user and their manager whether the access was part of the patient's care, payment, or operations; document the outcome.

rules.title: Access to a possible family member's record
rules.review: Confirm whether the user and patient are related and whether the access was job-related; apply your sanctions policy if not.

rules.title: Access to a coworker's medical record
rules.review: Verify a business reason with the user's manager; employees' records are a frequent target of curiosity-driven snooping.

rules.title: Access to a high-profile patient's record without a treatment relationship
rules.review: Review promptly; consider restricting high-profile records to the care team and alerting on every access.

rules.title: Access by an account after the person left
rules.review: Disable the account immediately, determine who used it and what was viewed, and assess whether a breach notification analysis is needed.

rules.title: Access outside normal working hours
rules.review: Confirm the user was scheduled to work; repeated after-hours access by office roles deserves a closer look.

rules.title: Unusually large number of records opened in one hour
rules.review: Determine whether a legitimate task explains the volume; bulk access can indicate data theft or a compromised account.

rules.title: Bulk printing or exporting of records
rules.review: Confirm the business purpose and where the printed or exported records went.

rules.title: Emergency (break-the-glass) access needs review
rules.review: Confirm a documented emergency justified the override.

rules.title: Shared, generic, or unknown account used to access records
rules.review: Replace shared logins with individual accounts so every access can be traced to one person.

rules.title: Repeated failed sign-in attempts
rules.review: Check whether the user forgot a password or someone tried to guess it; confirm the account was not then accessed by someone else.

rules.title: Account still active after termination
rules.review: Disable the account and add account removal to the offboarding checklist.
